scope: Curated reference metadata and original adaptation notes; no third-party implementation or media is bundled.

attribution.changes: Selected references with newly written task mappings, caveats and descriptions.

attribution.authors: OpenDesign / nexu-io/open-design contributors; inspect each package author and license before reuse
attribution.repository_default_license: Apache-2.0; local package licenses may differ
attribution.changes: Reference-only catalogue with original descriptions; no template source is copied.

excluded_catalog_examples.reason: Catalog summary describes an access-denied server error, not product content.
Catalog summary describes security verification, not the product/search interface.

entries.title: Linear
entries.description: Dark technical product presentation and structured product sections.
entries.caveat: Public marketing material does not establish the authenticated application's task layout.

entries.title: Stripe
entries.description: Split product hero and clear hierarchy for a technical financial offering.
entries.caveat: Do not transfer source colors or screenshot-specific 'no dark mode' advice as universal rules.

entries.title: Vercel
entries.description: Monochrome hierarchy, technical typography and a centered product presentation.
entries.caveat: Source mentions both shadows and no shadows; resolve against screenshot/computed evidence before adopting tokens.

entries.title: Mercury
entries.description: Photographic hero with serif display and restrained supporting content.
entries.caveat: This public promotional surface is not a verified banking dashboard.

entries.title: Supabase
entries.description: Developer-product presentation with clear section hierarchy and code-oriented context.
entries.caveat: Verify actual route, theme and source measurements before importing values.

entries.title: Raycast
entries.description: Productivity-product reference for product story and recognizable technical identity.
entries.caveat: A launcher marketing page does not prove command-palette keyboard behavior.

entries.title: Headspace
entries.description: Friendly wellness presentation and approachable visual tone.
entries.caveat: Check Thai font coverage and actual text/control contrast independently.

entries.title: Regrocery
entries.description: Warm image-led consumer product presentation.
entries.caveat: Catalog/spec review does not verify cart or payment interactions.

entries.title: Cubitts
entries.description: Editorial product imagery and typography for crafted objects.
entries.caveat: Product commerce mapping is an adaptation hypothesis, not a verified checkout.

entries.title: Lusion
entries.description: Expressive studio/portfolio direction and visual storytelling.
entries.caveat: Account for motion preferences, content access and rendering performance.

entries.title: Cowboy
entries.description: Neutral image-and-form composition.
entries.caveat: Reviewed spec centers on a newsletter modal; do not treat it as the whole storefront layout.

entries.title: Gleap
entries.description: Potential reference for an AI-support product proposition.
entries.caveat: Detail fetch failed; visual/layout suitability remains unverified.

entries.title: Framer
entries.description: Potential creative-tool marketing reference with expressive motion.
entries.caveat: Detail fetch failed; inspect actual content and reduced-motion behavior before adoption.

entries.title: Getdooapp
entries.description: Potential minimal productivity-app marketing reference.
entries.caveat: Detail fetch failed; device mockups are not validated native-app screens.

entries.title: Stripe Press
entries.description: Potential publishing/product editorial reference.
entries.caveat: Detail fetch failed; inspect long-form reading and purchase flow separately.

entries.title: Light
entries.description: Potential developer-infrastructure marketing reference.
entries.caveat: Only catalog metadata was reviewed; token and layout claims require pack inspection.

entries.title: Dashboard
entries.description: Sidebar, header, indicators and chart regions.
entries.caveat: Pick indicators from decisions; add real states and compact navigation.

entries.title: Pricing Page
entries.description: Plan options, comparison and frequently asked questions.
entries.caveat: Specify recurring costs, limits and billing-period semantics.

entries.title: Finance Report
entries.description: Financial summary, charts and a profit/loss table.
entries.caveat: Add units, reporting period, provisional status and source traceability.

entries.title: Flowai Live Dashboard Template
entries.description: Team views, member table, role breakdown and activity.
entries.caveat: Actual permissions, export and chart keyboard behavior still require implementation checks.

entries.title: Kanban Board
entries.description: Column-based work organization.
entries.caveat: Provide non-drag movement and distinguish persisted state from optimistic state.

entries.title: Meeting Notes
entries.description: Meeting context, agenda, decisions and owned action items.
entries.caveat: Use accessible table semantics and explicit owner/date fields.

entries.title: Wireframe Annotated
entries.description: Low-fidelity page regions with numbered specification notes.
entries.caveat: Treat annotations as handoff aids; they are not live interaction verification.

entries.title: Social Media Dashboard
entries.description: Platform context, engagement indicators, growth and content panels.
entries.caveat: Define metric meaning, data freshness and cross-platform comparability.
